s.p.learn.ai_p1: Ngokukhawuleza: uxoxe ngokubhaliweyo ne-AI ethandekayo, ngolwimi kunye nomphakamo okhethayo, kwisihloko (ukuhamba, umsebenzi, ubomi bemihla ngemihla). Ilizwi liya kuza emva.
s.p.learn.ai_p2: Kutheni akunjalo ngoku? Incoko ye-AI ifuna inkonzo yangaphandle. Isitshixo sayo kufuneka sihlale sifihlakele kwiseva, hayi kwiwebhusayithi. Akukho nto ivuliwe kwaye akukho xabiso liqhutywa ngaphandle kokwamkela kwakho.
s.p.learn.cult_p1: Ngokukhawuleza: iilizwe kunye nemimandla, iintshukumo, iintsomi, amanqaku kunye neevidiyo, ukufumanisa ulwimi.
s.p.learn.cult_p2: Isiqulatho sicwangciswe njengezifundo: ifayile enye nganye yomxholo, eyongezelelweyo ngaphandle kotshintsho lwenkqubo.
s.p.learn.match_how: Cofa igama, emva koko uguqulelo lwayo.
